title: Classic mixed vegetables, canned, cooked with oil

content.title: About
content.content: Classic mixed vegetables are a blend of carrots, peas, corn and beans cooked in vegetable oil. The vegetables are blanched before being sealed in glass jars, preserving flavor, color and nutrients.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The blend is formulated for a balanced taste and texture.
The product is ready to eat straight from the jar.
Cooking in oil increases caloric value but enhances absorption of fat‑soluble vitamins.
Dark glass jars protect the contents from light, slowing oxidation.
A small amount of salt and spices is often added for flavor.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: The vegetables provide vitamin B6 and folate, supporting metabolism and nervous system health.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber aids digestion and promotes satiety.

items.title: Contains antioxidants
items.content: Beta‑carotene and vitamin C help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Supports cardiovascular health
items.content: The vegetable oil used contains monounsaturated fats beneficial for the heart.

items.title: Provides essential minerals
items.content: Potassium and magnesium in the mix help regulate blood pressure and muscle function.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Added salt may be a concern for people with hypertension; portion control is advised.

items.title: Caloric density from oil
items.content: The oil raises the energy content, which may be undesirable in calorie‑restricted diets.

items.title: Allergy to vegetable oil
items.content: Some individuals may react to the type of oil used (e.g., sunflower oil).

items.title: Potential BPA in packaging
items.content: If the jar lid is coated with epoxy, bisphenol A exposure is possible; choose BPA‑free labeled products.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The vegetables can be eaten straight from the jar, added to salads, soups, stews, or used as a sandwich filling. They can also be gently warmed in a pan or microwave if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store unopened jars in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 3‑5 days.
